predict.question: Eight pending tasks sit in your mental to-do queue. Each round you write two onto a paper list, for three rounds. How many tasks remain in your mental queue?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: The Organized Mind discusses external organization as support for managing information and tasks.
modelBoundary: No transfers leaves {A}; recording two per round leaves {B}. Transferred tasks remain pending on another list.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? A smaller tracked queue does not prove reduced cognitive load or completed work.
